title: Christmas High Tea at The Marley House
seo_title: Christmas High Tea at The Marley House in Ozark, MO
description: This holiday high tea at The Marley House offers a tower of sweet and savory bites with your choice of Phoenix Tea Company tea, plus additional drinks from the bar. Guests ages 7 and up can attend, and those who bring a new toy for Santa's Toy Drive receive a $10 voucher to The Mill, valid through February 28, 2027. It takes place Friday, December 18, 2026, from 11:00 AM to 4:00 PM at 802 Finley Farms Lane, Ozark, MO; seating is pre-assigned, so groups should book under the same reservation.
